source_checklist.locator: Kruesi et al. eLife 2013 doi:10.7554/eLife.00808, original PDF https://cdn.elifesciences.org/elife-articles/00808/pdf/elife00808.pdf; reference 21 expressly inherited for GRO-cap

pass_1.locations: Original eLife PDF Methods pages 21–23, web-extracted lines 906–965, especially 932–965; run-on method lines 864–931
pass_1.finding: Kruesi prints GRO-cap's 3-prime TruSeq RA3 (part 15013207) ligation after first BrU capture, Terminator exonuclease and Antarctic phosphatase exclusion, TAP/control split, and then 5-prime TruSeq RA5 (part 15013205) ligation. Its preceding GRO-seq section prints RP1 and RPI PCR oligos. GRO-cap reverse transcription/amplification is delegated to Core 2008. The original PDF was subsequently fetched into the source bundle.

pass_2.locations: local elife00808.pdf.txt lines 1135-1161 (GRO-seq contrast), 1163-1203 (GRO-cap); original PDF Methods pp. 22-23
pass_2.finding: The explicit GRO-cap method ligates RA3 (part 15013207) to the 3-prime RNA after first BrU enrichment, repeats BrU capture, applies Terminator exonuclease and Antarctic phosphatase, splits TAP+/TAP−, ligates RA5 (part 15013205) to TAP+ 5-prime RNA, then captures BrU a third time. GRO-cap RT/PCR are delegated to Core 2008; GRO-seq circular RT primer on prior page is a different branch.

additional_checks.locations: Original Kruesi2013 PDF text1080–1132 (NRO/first capture),1135–1161 (adjacent GRO-seq completion),1163–1203 (GRO-cap),1205–1211 (joint read mapping); Methods pp21–23
additional_checks.finding: Independent reading confirms GRO-cap excludes base hydrolysis, uses RA3 after first BrU capture, second capture, Terminator digestion, Antarctic phosphatase, TAP+/no-TAP split, RA5 ligation, third capture, then explicit Core2008 RT/amplification/PAGE delegation. The circular RT primer and six-base RPI family above the GRO-cap heading belong to GRO-seq and are not assigned to GRO-cap. A positive adapter sequence is printed in the joint mapping section: cutadapt target TGGAATTCTCGGGTGCCAAGG matches current RA3. This establishes a historical read-through/trim target, not full ordered-strand modifications or a GRO-cap PCR/index assignment.
